character.name: Caius Maro
character.background: Paladin / Disgraced Noble, Falsely Accused of Treason

spells.name: Bless
spells.description: You bless up to three creatures of your choice within range. Whenever a target makes an attack roll or saving throw before the spell ends, they can roll 1d4 and add it to the roll.

spells.name: Cure Wounds
spells.description: A creature you touch regains a number of hit points equal to 1d8 + your spellcasting ability modifier.

traits: Stoic Fortitude: Advantage on saving throws against fear and charm effects, forged through years of battlefield hardship and betrayal
Unbreakable Honesty: Cannot utter a deliberate falsehood, even when a lie would save his life or further his goals
Oathbound Guilt: When he channels divine magic, he suffers 1 point of necrotic damage, a reminder of his broken vow
Traitor's Eye: Advantage on Insight checks to detect deception, after being betrayed by those he trusted most
character.gear: Oathbroken longsword · Dented steel shield · Travel-worn chain mail · Tarnished silver holy symbol · Dried venison rations (3) · Rusted iron dagger · Hempen rope (50ft) · Flint and steel
character.story: Caius Maro was the youngest captain of the Ivory Spire Paladins, until his liege lord framed him for regicide to cover his own treason. Caius let his oath break on purpose, rather than swear a false oath to uphold the liege's betrayal. Stripped of his title, his divine blessings withered as he abandoned the vow he could no longer honor in good faith. He walks the mist-choked borderlands now, his once-gleaming armor scarred and dull, seeking proof of his innocence or the traitor's throat. The guilt of his choice gnaws at him, but he will not rest until his name is cleared, or his vengeance is spent.

inventory.name: Oathbroken Longsword
inventory.lore: This notched longsword was forged for Caius when he was inducted into the Ivory Spire Paladins. The faint paladin runes along its blade have gone cold since his oath broke, and it no longer glows when fiends draw near.
inventory.description: A well-worn longsword with a cracked leather grip, its edge nicked from countless battles. The steel is stained dark in places with old blood.

inventory.name: Dented Steel Shield
inventory.lore: Dented in the skirmish where Caius was framed for regicide, this shield bears the cracked stag crest of House Maro. The deep arrow dent near its edge is a permanent reminder of the betrayal that destroyed his order.
inventory.description: A heavy round steel shield, scuffed and dented from years of use. The painted stag crest of House Maro is cracked down the middle.

inventory.name: Travel-Worn Chain Mail
inventory.lore: This suit of chain mail was passed down through three generations of House Maro. The iron links are stiff with grime and dried blood from the night of Caius's false accusation, and the wool lining still holds the faint scent of lavender his mother packed in it.
inventory.description: A full suit of heavy chain mail, scarred and stained from months of travel on the run. Several links are missing near the left shoulder, a wound from the arrow that nearly killed him the night he fled the Ivory Spire.

inventory.name: Tarnished Silver Holy Symbol
inventory.lore: This crude stag head holy symbol was given to Caius by his mentor when he took his paladin oath. It has not glowed with divine light since the night his connection to his god was severed, and only grows faintly warm when he channels the last dregs of his fading power.
inventory.description: A small, crudely carved stag head made of tarnished silver, hung on a frayed leather cord. The metal is cold to the touch unless Caius is actively channeling divine magic.
inventory.effects: Can be used to cast Shield of Faith once per day, as a 1st-level paladin spell, without expending a spell slot.

inventory.name: Dried Venison Rations (3)
inventory.lore: These rations were packed by Caius's younger sister when he was exiled from the Ivory Spire. He has only eaten one of the three strips, saving the rest for the journey home to clear his name.
inventory.description: Tough, chewy strips of venison, dried over a pine fire and wrapped in oiled cloth. They are tasteless but will stave off starvation for a full day per strip.

inventory.name: Rusted Iron Dagger
inventory.lore: This simple iron dagger was a gift from the castle stablehand when Caius was a boy, before he became a squire. He has carried it every day since, even when he was a full knight of the Ivory Spire.
inventory.description: A short iron dagger, rusted along its dull edge. The leather grip is worn smooth from years of use.

inventory.name: Hempen Rope (50ft)
inventory.lore: Caius stole this rope from the Ivory Spire armory the night he fled, using it to climb down the sheer western wall. It has since held his weight across chasms and secured countless campfires in the borderlands.
inventory.description: Coarse, frayed hempen rope, 50 feet long. One end is charred from being used to lower a campfire into a pit.

inventory.name: Flint and Steel
inventory.lore: This flint and steel was found in his father's saddlebags after he died in the border skirmishes. Caius took it the day he was exiled, and it is the only memento he has left of his family.
inventory.description: A chunk of grey flint and a steel striker, wrapped in oiled cloth to keep dry. It lights a fire in 1 round if used with tinder.
inventory.effects: Can be used to start a fire in dry conditions.
